translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Yagaba ibunaga damene bibahende Iyibi dindi penego ogo

Yagaba ibunaga mbirale wiarubi waneigini aguanene hearubi bibahende mo ngoai halu Iyibi dindi pole hariga peadagua pialu hene. Ani pialu howa dindi mbira mini Beseba wiagoria anda puwa Yagaba ibugua ibu aba Aisaganaga Ngode Datagaliwabehondo mbirale bo loma bu mini.
Ani buwa mbiraga Yagaba ibu paluwa de gandeba handalu hearia Ngode Datagaliwabe ibu ibuwa lalu, Yagaba-o Yagaba-o, lalu olene. Ani layagola Yagabahanda lalu, Ya i̱ o kogoni, lene.
Ani layagola Ngode Datagaliwabehanda lalu, Í̠ aba Aisaganaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kogonigo ai í̠naga waneigini aguaneneru mo dewaore heloleberogo í̠na Iyibi dindi gi nahe pobe.
I̱na í̠ heba Iyibi dindi pialu mani Kenana dindi lone haru dai bulebero. Í̠ homaregola í̠naga tingini Yosebe ibunime hora holebira, lene.
Egabi layagola Yagaba ibu igini biarume ti aba Yagaba tinaga one waneiginiru baba garo ale nogo hosime gili laga kini ibugua Iyibi howa ti yalu dai bilo ibilene biagoria berelowa yalu pene.
Yagaba ibunaga yári dabudabu wiaruni bibahendeore tinaga nogo bulumagarubi mbirale bibahende Kenana dindi yu hene wiaruni yaiore halu Iyibi dindi pene.
Yagaba waneiginirubi aguanerubi bibahendeore Iyibi dindi pole Yagaba ibuni heba piaiore hene.
Yagaba damene bibahendeore Iyibi dindiha ibu heba mandagi penerunaga mini uru. Yagaba igini wahene Lubene ibubi
Lubene iginiru Hanogobi Palubi Heseronobi Kami imaru ti pene.
Simiono ibu iginiru nde Yamuelebi Yaminibi Ohadabi Yaginibi Sohabi Saulubi uruni ti pene. Saulu ibu ai̱ya Kenana wali mbira berene.
Libai ibu iginiru nde Gesonobi Kohadabi Merari imaru pene.
Yuda ibu iginiru nde Selabi Peresebi Sera imaru pene. Yuda igini maru Ere Onanala kirabali Kenana dindi hemingi homene. Perese ibu igini Heserono Hamulula pene.
Isaga ibu igini Tolabi Puabi Yasububi Simirono imaru pene.
Ani bialu Sebulunu ibu igini nde Serede Elono Yalele imaru pene.

Yagaba one Lia ibu igini uruni bu hene. Lia ibugua igiri uruni Mesobodemia dindini hemingi taba hanaga bini. Liahanda wandari mbiraore hangu mini Daina taba henenego ogoni berene. Yagabanaga waneigini aguanerubi Liaha howa henego aria pira tebirani huniane tebira (33) ti bibahende Iyibi dindi pene.
Yagaba igini Gada ibu igini nde Sebonobi Hagibi Sunibi Esebonobi Eribi Arodobi Areli imaru henego tibi pene.
Ase iginiru nde Iminabi Isibabi Isibibi Beria imaru halu ibu wane Sera berenegobi uruni pene. Ani pialu Beria igini nde Hebe Malagielela libubi pene.

Wali agali uruni bibahende ti wali mbira mini Siliba ibu Lianaga biabe bia haga berelo Labanahanda ibu wane Lia minigo o biago Yagabala libu waneigini hene. Ti bibahende daga lamaga halu pira mbirani waragaria (16) pene.
Yagaba one mende Leselo ibugua Yagaba igini Yosebe Beniyaminila taba henene.

Anigo Yosebe ibu Iyibi dindiha heangi loma binigo mo miaga agali mbira mini Podibera ibu Heliobolisi tanoha henego ibu wane Asenada bereago ibu Yosebe one biruwa ibugua igiri kira Manase Eberaimila taba henene.
Beniyamini igini nde Belabi Begebi Asabelebi Gerabi Namanabi Ehibi Losobi Mubimibi Hubimibi Ada imaru hene.
Agali uruni pira mbirani maria (14) ti Yagaba Leselola libu aguaneru ti bibahende Iyibi dindi pene.
Dana ibu igini mbiraore hangu mini Husimi hene.
Nabadali ibu iginibi nde Yaselebi Gunibi Yasebi Sileme imaru hene.
Agali karia uruni bibahende Yagaba Bilihala libu waneigini aguaneru bu hene. Wali Biliha ogoni Labanahanda ibu wane Leselonaga biabe bia haga berelo minigo berene.
Yagaba ibu aruniru daga nale howa ibuni waneigini hangu Iyibi dindi pole peneru daga pira waragariani waragaria (66) pene.
Anigo Yosebe oneme igiri kira Iyibi dindini taba hanayago heba lamaga halu Yagaba ibu damene pira karia (70) Iyibi dindi pu hene.
Yagaba damene Iyibi dindini pu henego ogo
Yagabahanda Yuda abale bamba halu Yosebe Gosene dindini ngola hole ibilo, Lamima pu, lene. Ani bialu Yagaba dameneru Gosene dindini anda íbu heagola

Yosebehanda ibunaga agali biabe bia haga hearuhondo lalu, Gosene dindini i̱ aba lola hole poliya i̱naga garo ale mini karisi mo manda manda bidaba, lene. Ani bialu Yosebe ibu puwa ibu aba wanakuiore handalu dugu timbuni luore biaho wini.
Ani biyagola Yagabahanda Yosebehondo lalu, Áyu í̠ore homaribe toba harugo ndo henedago áyu hendedogo ai homaruyagua karulape kogoni, lene.
Ani layagola Yosebehanda ibu hameneru ibu aba waneigini bu hearuhondo lalu, Ai áyu ogoni kinihondo i̱ aba hameneru tinaga dindi andaru Kenana dindi ngelo wahalu oali anda íbu ka lalu lamule porogo.
Agali uruni ti nogo sibi hinaga howa ai tinaga mbirale wu hearu bibahende yalu ibai haya. Tinaga nogo bulumaga sibirubi bibahende haru ibiya lolebero.
Ani larogola kini ibugua tíhondo, Biabe agi dege biaga kamibe, lalu hale hayagua

tígua ibuhondo ogodagua ladai bilimu, Agali haguane-o inanaga biabe nogo sibi bulumagaru hinaga kamagoni. Inanaga aba mamarume biagadagua inabi nde igiri emeneni howa biabe ogoni biaga kamagoni, lalimu. Tígua ani larimiyagua ibugua, Tí dindi Gosene ogoria halimu, lalu dindi ogo tí ngulebirago ani lalimu, lene. Yosebehanda ibu hameneruhondo ani lalimu layago irane Iyibi wali agali tigua agali nogo sibi hinaga karu handabe manga hagago manda buwa ani lene.
